title_sq: Tek Kompleksi Green City, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1 Me Arredim Modern!!!!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi Green City, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1 Me Arredim Modern!!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 teknik te nje pallati te ri dhe te pajisur me ashensor, ndertim i vitit 2020. Ka stukture shume te rregullt, siperfaqe totale 107m² dhe siperfaqe neto 93m². Organizohet ne korridorin hyres, sallonin e ndenjes me kendin e gatimit dhe dalje ne ballkon, dhoma e gjumit matrimoniale me tualet te dedikuar me dritare, nje dhome tjeter gjumi dhe tualeti i dites po me dritare. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar me cilesi dhe stil. Kompleksi ofron hapesira te perbashketa te gjelberuara, 2 pishina private, kende lojrash, hapesira parkimi dhe shume sherbime te ndryshme. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: At Green City Complex, Super Apartment 2+1 With Modern Furnishing for Sale!!!!
description_en: At Green City Complex, Super Apartment 2+1 With Modern Furnishing for Sale!!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd technical floor of a new building equipped with an elevator, built in 2020. It has very regular structures, total area 107m² and net area 93m². It is organized in the entrance corridor, the living room with the kitchen corner and exit to the balcony, the matrimonial bedroom with a dedicated toilet with a window, another bedroom and the day toilet with a window. The apartment is fully furnished with quality and style. The complex offers common green spaces, 2 private swimming pools, playgrounds, parking spaces and many different services. Has regular mortgage documentation.
